about: Problems the 0.7 verifiers found that break or visibly glitch a quest.

entries.sql: UPDATE DataQuest SET SourceText = SourceText || '|' WHERE ID = 21188 AND (length(SourceText) - length(replace(SourceText, '|', ''))) < (length(StepType) - length(replace(StepType, '|', '')))
